maker: MYRO International Pte. Ltd. (Mojay Global Holding)
name: MYRO interior wall painting robot
summary: Mobile robot that spray-paints flat interior walls up to 3.1 m high from a floor plan drawn in its app, avoiding zones marked as not to be painted. Made by MYRO International (Singapore, branch in Dubai) and demonstrated on residential projects in the UAE, India, Brazil and Japan.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. MYRO International sells from Singapore and Dubai and offers distribution licences to regional partners; enquiries through its contact form.

specs.label: Painting rate
specs.conditions: maker benchmark from earlier projects; may vary
specs.quote: Efficiency is calculated at 100 m²/hour, MYRO's standard productivity benchmark

specs.label: Maximum wall height
specs.quote: MYRO is designed to paint walls up to 3.1 meters in height

specs.label: Set-up time
specs.quote: Connect MYRO and set up paint in 15-20 min

specs.label: Control
specs.value: MYRO app on iOS or Android: floor plan, non-paintable zones, automatic painting
specs.quote: MYRO can be controlled through any IOS and Android device

specs.label: Spray set-up on a demo job
specs.quote: The use of LP521 spray tips at 1800 psi ensured optimal distribution

notes: Flat indoor walls up to 3.1 m; the maker says to leave taller areas out of its calculator. On the Mumbai demo the ceiling was sprayed by hand with an airless gun.
Navigates with sensors and avoids collisions; works best on large regular surfaces (press).
Mobile base with a spray mast assumed; wheels and arm layout not described on readable pages.

evidence.task: Two-coat wall painting on the 12th floor of a residential tower during a two-day on-site demonstration (20 m × 2.75 m wall)
evidence.where: Sky City Borivali (Oberoi Construction), Mumbai, India
evidence.note: The page gives both 115 m² and 55 m² for the area painted in two days.

evidence.where: GITEX Technology Week, Dubai World Trade Centre, United Arab Emirates
